But the problem arises when different schools of thought start rejecting each other and go to such an extent that they call eachother KAFIR , and other ideologies as BATIL. Still they may not feel any problem for themselves ,but it does become a problem for a common man when he tries return towards the Din of Allah, or when he becomes serious about Islam and wishes to work in the way of Allah . because it is a must to join an organization to work in a coordinated and fruitfull manner . but at this moment one has to decide which organization is on truth (Islam) . answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 10044 Country: Bangladesh Title: Assalamualaikum, m student of A'Level (intermediate level) and beside m in touch with Tabligh. In most of the time i have to face questions that are 'Where it is written to sleep in Mashjid?' and 'Where it is written going for Chilla (40 days)?' Please clearify the facts! Jazakallahu khayra. Question: Assalamualaikum, m student of A'Level (intermediate level) and beside m in touch with Tabligh. In most of the time i have to face questions that are 'Where it is written to sleep in Mashjid?' and 'Where it is written going for Chilla (40 days)?' Please clearify the facts! Jazakallahu khayra. Answer ID: 10044 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 54/54=M/1429) The scholars of Fiqh say that traveller and one who has had an intention of itikaf can sleep in mosque. (Fatawa Hindiyah) The elders of Jamat have designed the schedule of 40 days; since 40 days have a special importance in changing conditions. It is proved by indications from the Quran and Hadith and experiments. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
